announcements.title: Please update to 2.8.0
announcements.message: Older versions can make YouTube stop playing videos on your account for a while after a big sync. 2.8.0 fixes that, so please update as soon as you can. To update now: open chrome://extensions, switch on Developer mode (top right) and click Update. Same on Edge at edge://extensions. On Firefox, open about:addons, click the gear, then Check for Updates.

body.text: Older versions can make YouTube **stop playing videos** on your account for a while after a big sync. 2.8.0 fixes that, so please update as soon as you can.

**To update now:** open chrome://extensions, switch on **Developer mode** (top right) and click **Update**. Same on Edge at edge://extensions. On Firefox, open about:addons, click the gear, then **Check for Updates**.
Otherwise your browser updates it by itself, usually within a day. Questions? Ask on [Discord](https://discord.gg/sTvjfp4sCk).

announcements.title: What's new in 2.8.0
announcements.message: Please update as soon as you can: older versions can make YouTube stop playing videos after a big sync. To update now, open chrome://extensions, switch on Developer mode and click Update. A big sync now opens your list straight away and fills in tags, music, Shorts and upload dates behind it, spaced out so YouTube doesn't pause your account. Also new: Search all videos, Play as queue, and for Pro, search through descriptions. Questions? https://discord.gg/sTvjfp4sCk

body.text: **Please update as soon as you can,** especially if your list has thousands of videos. Older versions can make YouTube stop playing videos for a while after a big sync, and 2.8.0 fixes that.

**To update now:** open chrome://extensions, switch on **Developer mode** (top right) and click **Update**. Same on Edge at edge://extensions. On Firefox, open about:addons, click the gear, then **Check for Updates**.
A big sync now **opens your list straight away**. Tags, music, Shorts and upload dates fill in behind it, about 30 minutes for 4,000 videos, spaced out so YouTube doesn't pause your account.

list: The sidebar shows how far it has got, and **Resume sync** reads the rest if a sync stops early
**Music only** and **No music** leave out videos not read yet
**Search all videos** from the sidebar search
**Play as queue**: one tab plays up to 50 ticked videos, in the order you ticked them
Pro: search looks through video descriptions, and the **Playlists** menu finds a playlist by its creator
